marker_rule: Unique contiguous pulse train containing each ID exactly once; normal1..10, gap1..12. abs(width_us-(2*ID+0.24))<=0.80 at native0.5us grid. Gap requires3<11<12<4<5; all unmatched edges retained.
onset_definition: First >=20mA native sample in500ms before receiver marker; preceding1ms finite with absolute mean<100uA.
plateau_definition: First whole1ms bin after marker10 with10 consecutive bin means6..12mA;1ms endpoint resolution.
qualification: Post5ms window finite/contiguous, native power integrated; first5ms and whole-cycle integrals remain provisional. Markers establish firmware observations, not independent image integrity or Standby flags. Gap is a diagnostic scheduling change, not a selected energy optimization. Peak comparisons use1ms/10ms mean windows, never native extrema.
limits: Input-side JS voltage, not target voltage after sense/wire drops.
Final packed GPIO chunk excluded; all remaining unmatched edges preserved.
Normal flash cycles include camera, card and populated Nucleo support loads.
Card initialization, slot scan and write latency can vary; report each run and interval rather than attributing every time change to PHY power-down.
Native extrema are retained but not qualified physical peaks.
gap_boundary_qualification: Direct native GPIO11/12 rising edges; no200ms subtraction or DWT-clock inference. Marker11 follows full-frame validation and sensor STOP; it is not the hardware STOP edge itself.
gap_baseline_scope: All board loads remain powered. Sensor has completed STOP, PHY power-down is intended, and SD is electrically powered but not initialized; not a measurement of SD-only idle current.
